agent_priors_used: General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): output-injecting agents exhibit path dependence / local continuation, so a lane's inherited next_question is evidence about its local frontier, not an agenda; the director recomputes the most valuable question from the whole map.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a capability demonstrated only in a research harness cannot be assumed to transfer to the shipped path; treatment-arm liveness and causal attribution must precede any efficacy comparison.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): an instrument validated only against interventions its own author authored has an unmeasured construct boundary and should not be trusted for arbitrary real-world changes until an out-of-author change is detected.

General measurement prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a benchmark whose comparator sits at ceiling has no dynamic range and cannot support an effect claim; a headroom/dynamic-range certificate must be checked before freezing, and when a family of designs fails by construction (unsatisfiable predicates, empty accept regions, dead controls) a pre-freeze satisfiability certificate is cheaper than another execution cycle.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): small CPU-quantized language models are typically unreliable multi-step tool-use agents, so scaling the local model class is a cheap bounded test that either unblocks an external-agent benchmark or justifies re-scoping it - it should not be assumed either way.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): an external dependency the factory cannot satisfy (a model credential) should not silently gate the critical path when a credential-free proxy can still advance the same decision, but the dependency must be actively resolved or explicitly declared unresolvable.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Cognitive reset performed. Alternatives considered and rejected: resuming the external comparator/census line (C-CROSSSITE) has low leverage while no model can act; deriving an external break-even for C-PRODUCT-ECON was already resolved as a valid scientific negative at EXP-INTEL-37950616801; and re-running the endpoint-existence question is pointless because existence is settled. The model-CAPABILITY determination is the highest-leverage external/tooling question because it gates three claims, is bounded and cheap relative to a full benchmark, and has a clean both-directions outcome. It stays in Intel rather than Product because it is a comparative model/baseline capability determination, which is Intel's charter, not product simplification.
allocation.question: Can the factory provision, without a human-issued credential, a budget-stable model endpoint or local runtime able to drive a multi-step Web-agent task with parseable JSON actions and deterministic mechanical verification under the frozen same-model/tools/budget constraint - specifically, does the largest accessible CPU-quantized local GGUF in the 3B-8B class (via llama.cpp, obtained through the confirmed huggingface.co resolve-redirect route), or any alternative stable anonymous provider, clear the minimal Web-agent capability bar (emit a valid parseable JSON action and complete a deterministic multi-step task) that Qwen2.5-0.5B and the pollinations proxy both failed at EXP-INTEL-37973264582 - and if no accessible credential-free model clears that bar, produce the exact provisioning receipt plus the re-scope recommendation (drop Gate 3's external same-model anchor in favour of internally re-run comparators with their own reported quality on a task bank with dynamic range), so the frozen C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark can either run as specified or be explicitly and accountably re-scoped. Preregister a both-directions falsifier and a stopping rule: success unblocks the benchmark; exhaustion of the accessible credential-free model size range closes the credential-free external-agent path.
allocation.rationale: The single most decision-changing open fact for SPIDER's flagship external-agent claims (C-LLM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-PRODUCT-ECON) is that no currently accessible credential-free model can drive a minimal multi-step Web task, established by EXP-INTEL-37973264582 (audit PASS; frozen label DESIGN_COMPROMISED): the 0.5B local model emitted no parseable JSON action and the pollinations proxy returned empty/reasoning-only content under a ~197-token cap. The next bounded, decision-changing step is to test the largest accessible credential-free model class (3B-8B GGUF via the confirmed huggingface.co route, and any alternative stable anonymous provider) on the same minimal capability bar, with a definitive stopping rule: success unblocks the frozen four-arm benchmark; exhaustion of the accessible range closes the credential-free external-agent path and licenses an explicit re-scope. Leaving this unresolved strands three claims.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER's objective is unchanged: show that a real external agent's cost per successful Web task tracks residual novelty rather than full task length, while remaining correct under drift. The Codex establishes only bounded ingredients - C-MEAS-VALID EXPERIMENTAL (strongest infrastructural claim, last scope bound in flight), C-PARAM-INHERIT EXPERIMENTAL (the shipped parameterized distill->resolve->execute path is now demonstrated live and causally attributable on a real credential-free substrate, but the certificate had ZERO dynamic range because the comparators saturated at success=1.0, so no economics was measured), and C-FRESHNESS, C-DELTA-REPAIR, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-WEB-DYNAMICS, C-CROSSSITE, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE all at HYPOTHESIS. No canonical packet yet validates the integrated chain: observation -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the shipped kernel -> applicability/freshness decision -> real external agent action -> lower end-to-end successful-task cost. Three lanes hold transactions that must complete under their frozen design and are preserved untouched: Frontier EXP-FRONTIER-37950626378 (result.json COMPLETE / outcome=SUPPORTS, awaiting independent audit), Physics EXP-PHYSICS-37973239386 and Runtime EXP-RUNTIME-37973247935 (both mid-execution at the snapshot). Graph holds a directed PREFREEZE (EXP-GRAPH-37978902447) that repairs its third consecutive control-plane design defect (a conjoined, unsatisfiable GATE-C3 predicate) and is resumed unchanged. The two idle lanes receive the most decision-changing credential-free work available: Intel must determine whether ANY accessible credential-free model can drive a minimal multi-step Web-agent task (the fact that currently gates C-LLM-INHERIT after EXP-INTEL-37973264582's DESIGN_COMPROMISED finding), and Product must build the dynamic-range task bank and measure the end-to-end cost/novelty curve on the now-live inherited path (C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY), which is credential-free and is the program audit's named missing measurement. No lane is PARKed or TERMINATED: every banked direction is either a live frozen transaction, a specific control-plane repair on the critical path, or a decision-changing orthogonal measurement.
